deals.offer: $0 delivery fee on Smoked Brisket orders of $10+
deals.how: Nov 5-18, order delivery on the Chipotle app or chipotle.com with a Smoked Brisket entrée and at least $10 of food (before tax and fees) and the delivery fee is $0. Delivery menu prices are higher and service fees still apply. Not on third-party apps, catering or Burritos by the Box.

deals.offer: Free 6-piece wings with a $10+ order on Mondays

deals.ask: No code. Look for the Monday wings offer in the Popeyes app or website.

deals.offer: $8 Quarter Pounder with Cheese meal
deals.how: Starting Nov 2 for a limited time: a Quarter Pounder with Cheese, medium fries and a drink for $8. Not valid on delivery. Price and participation may vary by location.
deals.ask: No code. Just ask for the $8 Quarter Pounder with Cheese meal.

deals.offer: All iced espresso and matcha drinks from $3
deals.how: Through Nov 29, every Wawa iced espresso and matcha drink starts at $3, including the fall flavors and the new holiday drinks. Bigger sizes and add-ons like cold foam cost more. Smoothies and hot chocolate aren't included.
deals.ask: No code. Just order at the kiosk or counter.

deals.offer: Free 6-piece nuggets with a $5 purchase
deals.how: Wednesdays. Wendy's Rewards members get a free 6-piece nuggets with a $5+ order in the Wendy's app or order.wendys.com. Find it in the app's Offers tab. Participating locations.
deals.ask: No code. Tap it in the Wendy's app's Offers tab.

deals.offer: Buy one pizza, get one free
deals.how: Two For Tuesday, dine-in or to-go. Buy one pizza, get one free; Hand-Stretched Artisan Pizzas don't count. There's a Bertucci's at Christiana. Ask your location for the fine print.
deals.ask: No code. Just ask for Two For Tuesday.

deals.offer: Kids eat free with an adult entrée
deals.how: Mondays. One free kids' meal for each full-price adult entrée. Dine in and tell your server, or order online at outback.com with the code. Participating locations only, can't be combined with other offers.
deals.ask: Dining in? Just ask for the Free Joey Meal.

deals.offer: Walkabout Wednesday: sirloin or chicken, Aussie Fries and a drink from $13.99
deals.how: Wednesdays, dine-in only. A 6oz sirloin or Grilled Chicken on the Barbie with Aussie Fries and a 16oz domestic draft or Coke product. Beer option not offered in PA. Prices and participation vary; limited time.
deals.ask: No code. Ask your server for Walkabout Wednesday.

deals.offer: Tuesday Tails: sirloin + lobster tail + 2 sides from $24.99
deals.how: Tuesdays, dine-in only. A 6oz sirloin and a lobster tail with two sides. Prices and participation vary by location.
deals.ask: No code. Ask your server for Tuesday Tails.

deals.offer: Half off a Dave's Single with any purchase, once a week
deals.how: Wendy's Rewards members ordering in the Wendy's app or online can get 50% off a Dave's Single with any purchase. Enter the code once in Redeem Promo Code; it can be used once a week (resets Saturdays) through Dec 4. Boo! Books don't count as the purchase.

deals.offer: Free Chicken Shack or lettuce wrap with a $10+ order on Sundays
deals.how: Every Sunday through Dec 27, 10am–10pm. Use the code at an in-Shack kiosk, in the Shake Shack app or on shakeshack.com. You need at least $10 of other food or drinks; one free item per order and paid add-ons cost extra. Not valid at drive-thrus, airports or stadiums, or on third-party delivery apps.

deals.how: Nov 11 only. Veterans and active-duty military get a free entrée from a special Veterans Day menu. Dine-in only, proof of service required, drinks and tip not included. Participating locations.

deals.offer: Free entrée for veterans and active duty on Veterans Day
deals.how: Nov 11 only. Veterans and active-duty military get a free entrée from a select Veterans Day menu. Dine-in only, ID required, participating locations.

deals.how: Nov 11 only. Veterans and active-duty military get a free Red's Big Tavern Burger with Bottomless Steak Fries. Dine-in only, military ID or proof of service required, participating locations.
deals.ask: No code. Show military ID or proof of service.

deals.offer: Free chips and guac, queso or salsa for veterans with $5 purchase
deals.how: Nov 11 only. Veterans and active-duty military with ID get free chips plus guacamole, queso blanco or salsa with a $5+ purchase. Participating locations.
deals.ask: No code. Show military ID at the register.

deals.offer: Free tall brewed coffee for veterans, service members and spouses
deals.how: Nov 11 only. Veterans, service members and military spouses get a free tall (12 oz) hot or iced brewed coffee at participating stores.
deals.ask: No code. Just tell the barista you're a veteran, service member or military spouse.

deals.offer: Free ShackBurger, chicken sandwich or 6 chicken bites with a $10+ order on Sundays
deals.how: Every Sunday through Dec 27. Pick one free item (ShackBurger, Chicken Shack, West Coast Chicken Sandwich or 6-piece chicken bites) when you have at least $10 of other food or drinks. Kiosk orders in the Shack, or pickup and delivery in the Shake Shack app or website. One per order, max $9.99 off. Not at drive-thrus, airports or stadiums, or on third-party delivery apps.

deals.offer: Free Bloomin' Onion and a drink for veterans and active duty, Nov 10–11
deals.how: Nov 10 and 11 only. Active, retired and veteran military get a free Bloomin' Onion and a free Coke product or domestic draft. Dine in or call in a to-go order (not online or delivery apps). Dine Rewards members who dine in also get a free Hero's Meal to use Nov 16 through May 2, 2027. Participating locations.

deals.offer: Free coffee for veterans, active duty and their families on Veterans Day
deals.how: Nov 11 only. Veterans, active-duty military and their families get a free hot or iced coffee, any size, at Wawa stores.
deals.ask: No code. Just tell the cashier you served.

deals.offer: Free donut for veterans and active military on Veterans Day
deals.how: Nov 11 only. Active and retired military get one free donut in store, while supplies last. Not on mobile app orders.
deals.ask: No code. Just ask at the counter.

deals.offer: Free Original Grand Slam for veterans and active duty
deals.how: Nov 11 only, from opening until noon. Veterans and active-duty military get a free Original Grand Slam. Dine-in, military ID or proof of service required, participating locations.
deals.ask: No code. Show military ID or proof of service.

deals.offer: Free entrée for veterans and active duty on Veterans Day
deals.how: Nov 11 only. Veterans and active-duty military get a free entrée from a special menu (dishes like chicken parm and fettuccine alfredo). Dine-in only, proof of service required.
deals.ask: No code. Show proof of service and ask for the Veterans Day menu.

deals.offer: Free meal voucher for veterans and active duty
deals.how: Nov 11, 11am–2pm, veterans and active-duty military pick up a voucher for a free meal (one of 10 entrées, two sides and a drink) to use later, through May 31, 2027. Proof of service required (military or VA card, or discharge papers). Participating locations.
deals.ask: No code. Stop by 11am–2pm on Nov 11 with proof of service.

deals.offer: 6 free boneless wings every week with a $15 online order
deals.how: Through Jan 10, 2027. Club Applebee's members get a new code by email every Sunday, good Sunday–Thursday that week for 6 free Boneless Wings on an online or app To Go order of $15+ (not counting alcohol, tax, fees or tip). One per week. Not on third-party delivery apps. Free to join.
deals.ask: No public code. Join Club Applebee's and use the code they email you each Sunday.

deals.offer: Free large 1-topping pizza for posting a photo review
deals.how: Nov 9–22. Place a $15+ order, then upload an unedited photo of your pizza and an honest review to earn a free large one-topping pizza in Papa Rewards. Use it on a later order of $5+.
deals.ask: No code. Order as a Papa Rewards member and look for the review prompt.

deals.offer: Large 1-topping pizza from $8.99 for carryout

deals.offer: $7.99 Dave's Single, small fry and small drink
deals.how: For a limited time, a Dave's Single with a small fry and small soft drink is $7.99. No offer needed. Prices vary and are higher on delivery.

deals.offer: 75¢ wings on Wednesdays
deals.how: Wings are 75 cents each on Wednesdays, ordered in multiples of 5. Their site also lists a $8.50 cheesesteak with chips on Tuesdays and a $8.50 cheeseburger with chips on Thursdays.

deals.offer: $10 burgers on Mondays

deals.offer: $15 tacos on Taco Tuesday
deals.how: On Tuesday nights each taco order is $15, including shrimp and fish tacos that are normally $17. Dine-in only. Takeout is regular price.

deals.offer: Kids eat free, Monday to Thursday
deals.how: Monday to Thursday, kids 10 and under eat free when an adult buys a hibachi entrée. Not valid on holidays.

deals.offer: $45 Sunday dinner for two
deals.how: On Sundays, two people share one appetizer and get two entrées for $45 total.

deals.offer: Kids 2 and under free, ages 7–12 half price
deals.how: At this all-you-can-eat steakhouse, kids 2 and under eat free, ages 3–6 pay $10 and ages 7–12 pay half price.

deals.offer: $1 wings on Sundays
deals.how: Wings are $1 each on Sundays. Other weekly deals: $3 Lil' Buddys Monday, $1.50 hot dogs Tuesday, half-price fries Wednesday and $1 off signature burgers Friday. Add-ons like cheese or bacon cost extra.

deals.offer: $3 Lil' Buddy burgers on Mondays
deals.how: Lil' Buddy burgers are $3 each on Mondays. Thursday has a $9.99 chicken sandwich or cheesesteak combo, and Sunday has $1 wings. Add-ons like cheese or bacon cost extra.

deals.offer: Taco Tuesday: $4 build-your-own tacos

deals.offer: $5 off two large pizzas
deals.how: Take $5 off any two large pizzas, Tuesday through Thursday only.

deals.offer: $8.75 large pizza Wednesdays
deals.how: Wednesdays a large pizza is $8.75 from 10am–4pm and $10.75 from 4pm to close. Pickup only; toppings extra. Also: large Sicilian $18 on Tuesday, two spaghetti dinners $16 on Sunday.

deals.offer: All-you-can-eat pizza & soda $8.99
deals.how: All-you-can-eat pizza and soda is $8.99 every day, and all-you-can-eat pasta and salad is $9.99. Dining room only. Tuesdays, medium pizzas are $5 off for dine-in.

deals.offer: Two large cheese pizzas $27.93 on Mondays
deals.how: Two large cheese pizzas are $27.93 all day Monday. Thursday has two large pizzas, 15 wings and a 2-liter for $55.04. Tax and extra toppings not included; deals can't be combined.

deals.offer: $8.49 lunch specials with a soda
deals.how: Weekday lunch specials include a soda: grilled chicken sandwich $8.49 on Tuesday, cheeseburger $8.49 on Wednesday, any wrap $8.49 on Thursday. Friday and Saturday have different lunch specials; no Monday special.

deals.offer: Lunch combos from $6.99
deals.how: Daily 11am–3pm: two plain slices and a soda $6.99, six wings with fries and a soda $12.99, cheeseburger with fries and a soda $13.99.
